elements.name: Chlorine
elements.decay: 36 Ar or 36S (33Cl) + β- + ε after 301*10³ years

elements.name: Cobalt
elements.decay: 60Co (60Ni + β- + νe + γ), 56,58Co(56,58Fe + β+ + νe ), 57Co(57Fe + electron capture + νe )

elements.name: Krypton
elements.decay: 78Se, 79Br + β+ + νe , 81Br + electron capture + νe (81mKr), 85Rb + β- (85Kr)

elements.name: Molybdenum
elements.notes: Molybdenum does not occur naturally as a free metal on Earth; in its minerals, it is found only in oxidized states.

elements.name: Ruthenium
elements.notes: Rare transition metal belonging to the platinum group of the periodic table.

elements.name: Rhodium
elements.notes: It is a very rare, silvery-white, hard, corrosion-resistant transition metal. Noble metal.

elements.name: Palladium
elements.notes: It is a rare and lustrous silvery-white metal.

elements.name: Silver
elements.notes: Silver is found in the Earth's crust in the pure, free elemental form ("native silver"), as an alloy with gold and other metals.

elements.name: Cadmium
elements.notes: Cadmium occurs as a minor component in most zinc ores and is a byproduct of zinc production.

elements.name: Iridium
elements.notes: Indium is a shiny silvery-white, highly ductile post-transition metal with a bright luster. It is so soft (Mohs hardness 1.2) that it can be cut with a knife and leaves a visible line like a pencil when rubbed on paper.[.

elements.name: Tin
elements.notes: Indium is a shiny silvery-white, highly ductile post-transition metal with a bright luster. It is so soft (Mohs hardness 1.2) that it can be cut with a knife and leaves a visible line like a pencil when rubbed on paper.[.

elements.name: Antimonium
elements.notes: Indium is a shiny silvery-white, highly ductile post-transition metal with a bright luster. It is so soft (Mohs hardness 1.2) that it can be cut with a knife and leaves a visible line like a pencil when rubbed on paper.[.

elements.name: Tellurium
elements.notes: Tellurium is far more common in the universe as a whole than on Earth.

elements.name: Iodine
elements.notes: Semi-lustrous, non-metallic solid that melts to form a deep violet liquid, and boils to a violet gas.

elements.name: Xenon
elements.notes: Naturally occurring xenon consists of seven stable isotopes and two long-lived radioactive isotopes.

elements.name: Caesium
elements.notes: It is the least electronegative stable element, with a value of 0.79 on the Pauling scale.

elements.name: Barium
elements.notes: Because of its high chemical reactivity, barium is never found in nature as a free element.

elements.name: Lanthanum
elements.notes: First of the metals of the f-block.

elements.name: Cerium
elements.notes: Second of the metals of the f-block.

elements.name: Polonium
elements.isotopes: 210Po: trace, average life of 138 d, (206, 208,209)Po: synthetic, 209Po life of 3y

elements.name: Curium
elements.isotopes: 247Cm lifespan of 1.57e07 years, all isotopes synthetic

elements.name: Berkelium
elements.isotopes: 248 Bk lifespan of about 9 years, all isotopes synthetic

elements.name: Californium
elements.notes: Californium is a radioactive actinide metal with a silvery appearance. It is highly radioactive and has no significant commercial applications.
